system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: Copy agents to `.agents/skills/` (and `.claude/skills/` for Claude Code)
system_prompt_style.note: Skills (SKILL.md files) are installed and loaded into the host engine's prompt; entry files like CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md composed per engine.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: **Scout** | Maps the surface: folder structure, languages, frameworks, dependencies, entry points
env_context_strategy.note: Agents explore the legacy repo with the host engine's tools.

observation_format.evidence_quote: **Visor** | Documents the interface from screenshots, without needing the system to be running
observation_format.note: Artifacts are markdown; Visor consumes user-supplied screenshots but the harness itself ships no image observation pipeline.

tool_call_format.note: Tool invocation is delegated to the host engine (Claude Code, Codex, etc.); not specified in the repo evidence.

tool_schema_source.note: Agent capabilities are hand-authored SKILL.md markdown skills.

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: Reversa **does not request, store, or transmit API keys from any LLM service.** All intelligence is delegated to the AI agent already present in your environment
protocol_standardization.note: No MCP/A2A client in the file tree (lib/ contains only installer commands).

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: The Discovery pipeline (`/reversa`) is the heart of the framework: a 5-phase sequence orchestrated by the **Reversa** agent.
loop_primitives.note: Default is the staged Discovery pipeline; orchestrator creates an exploration plan first.

planning_granularity.note: Also actions.md / roadmap.md in the forward cycle.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: **Reversa** | Central orchestrator. Coordinates all agents, saves checkpoints, guides the user

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: Each orchestrator pauses between agents and asks for `CONTINUAR` before advancing
delegation_mechanism.note: Control passes from one skill/role to the next within the same session.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: Each orchestrator pauses between agents and asks for `CONTINUAR` before advancing, so you stay in control of every step.
human_in_loop.note: `/reversa-autonomous` concentrates questions in one interview and runs without stops (configurable); Reviewer validates gaps with the user.

long_term_memory.note: Generated specs under _reversa_sdd/ persist across runs and are re-consumed by later teams.

state_persistence.evidence_quote: Progress is saved in `.reversa/state.json` at each checkpoint — if the session is interrupted, just type `reversa` to resume where you left off.

self_verification.evidence_quote: **Reviewer** | Reviews specs, finds inconsistencies, and validates gaps with the user
self_verification.note: Bug Debate adds an isolated judge (llm_judge) as opt-in; Code Quality agents require characterization tests but only in that opt-in team.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: Each orchestrator pauses between agents and asks for `CONTINUAR` before advancing
retry_policy.note: No task-level retry loop described in the pipeline.

rollback.evidence_quote: you can restore the original state with `git restore .` or from the backup copy.
rollback.note: Rollback is a user-side recommendation, not harness-automated; Code Quality gate is described as a 'reversible diff gate'.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: a 5-phase sequence orchestrated by the **Reversa** agent
termination_condition.note: Run ends when the pipeline phases complete; no step/token/cost caps in the repo evidence.

cost_controls.evidence_quote: Reversa **does not request, store, or transmit API keys from any LLM service.**
cost_controls.note: Token cost is borne by the host engine; Reconstructor 'implements one task at a time, preserving tokens' is a prompting heuristic, not a budget.

timeouts.evidence_quote: npx reversa status # Show current analysis state
timeouts.note: No timeout mechanism appears in the CLI or agent descriptions.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote:
In the root of the legacy project:

```bash
npx reversa install
```
execution_isolation.note: Reversa installs skills into the user's local project; execution happens inside the host coding agent on the host machine.

filesystem_access.evidence_quote: all writes are restricted to `.reversa/` and `_reversa_sdd/`** — no other file in your project is touched.
filesystem_access.note: Read access is repo-wide; write scope enforced by prompt directive.

network_policy.evidence_quote: no destructive or outward-facing command (delete, `git push`, publish, install) is ever run on its own
network_policy.note: No network restriction mechanism; outward commands merely gated by instruction.

permission_model.evidence_quote: no destructive or outward-facing command (delete, `git push`, publish, install) is ever run on its own
permission_model.note: Prompt-level blocklist of destructive actions plus write-path scoping; not code-enforced.

replayability.evidence_quote: if the session is interrupted, just type `reversa` to resume where you left off.

eval_hooks.evidence_quote: expert precision and utility in downstream tasks were proposed as protocol metrics, but have not yet been measured in a controlled way
eval_hooks.note: Evaluation protocol is proposed in the paper; no evaluation runner ships in the repo file tree.

guardrails.evidence_quote: agents operate under a strict and inviolable directive: **all writes are restricted to `.reversa/` and `_reversa_sdd/`**
guardrails.note: lib/installer/policy.js and validator.js implement installer-side policy checks.

target_domain.evidence_quote: Transform legacy systems into executable specifications for AI coding agents

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: All intelligence is delegated to the AI agent already present in your environment (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, etc.) — no external authentication dependencies.

primary_artifact.note: Repo tag postdates the May 2026 paper snapshot.

first_release_date.note: No release/tag history other than v1.2.57 in the evidence.
